title: Rho
description: Crisp fintech in two tones: a white page with ink text and cool grey-teal tinted cards, and a near-black twin with off-white text, both sharing one mint-teal for CTAs, eyebrow labels and chips. A slightly narrow neo-grotesk at regular weight with a grotesk mono for labels; 8px corners, flat surfaces, hairlines in grey-teal.
notes: light is the faithful mode: the original alternates light and dark sections; rho blocks take tone="dark" for the dark ones
Instrument Sans stands in for PP Neue Montreal (closed); DM Mono for Apercu Mono (closed)
--muted is the grey-teal 8% tint the original uses for cards; --card is the same, opaque
